title: Degree-only bounds for polynomial D(n)-tuples
exact_target: Can polynomial Diophantine tuples be bounded in size solely by the degree of the parameter polynomial?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 8500010 (AMR-084-0010). CC BY 4.0.
Andrej Dujella, Diophantine m-tuples, author-maintained survey (snapshot accessed 9 October 2026), Section 7.2, definition of polynomial tuples and degree-only upper-bound question.
